execution_backend: Connected GitHub source content analyzed in JavaScript; independent Python full-corpus rerun not completed
scope: 100 curated HotpotQA-derived authentic questions, supplied question-local 10-document candidate pools. No end-to-end QA, no model trained, no full-corpus physical Zstd cost.

computed_link_graph.definition: Directed exact whole-token target document title occurrence in a different candidate's source body, among the ten question-local candidate documents
computed_link_graph.warning: Two modeled metadata numbers are not measured SQLite index footprints; do not add to actual results as if they were measured.

interpretation: Recapitulates the existing Round25 quality baseline and quantifies candidate title-link graph density; NOT a new held-out result, and title links do not establish entailment.
